summary: Catalog policy re-emission: pass slots published before the re_entry ride-along never reach access
description: TKT-87 ai-review incidental (gpt-5.6-sol arm, G1). A slot published before the re_entry field existed has retained publication events without the field; access's projector writes explicit single and the publish path never re-emits an acknowledged publication. Any pre-existing multi/count_limited slot therefore enforces single forever, with no operator signal. Needs a catalog re-emission or backfill path (the projection's upsert already converges on a new envelope id) — the residual gap the TKT-87 plan named. Constraints: ADR-017 (any payload/schema decision), deterministic publication event ids (events.go EventID).
